No-Bake Chocolate Peanut Butter Macaroons
By: Kris Alcantara
Published: Tuesday, July 13, 2010 - 7:49pm

Ingredients




1/4 cup milk
1/2 cup coconut
3 tablespoons cocoa
1/4 cup butter
1 cup brown sugar
1/4 teaspoon vanilla
1 1/2 cups quick cooking oats
peanut butter to garnish

Preparation

1 In a pot, boil milk, cocoa, butter, and brown sugar for two minutes. 2 Remove from heat and add vanilla. 3 Add oats and coconut. Mix well! 4 With a spoon, scoop out mixture onto wax paper and set aside to cool. 5 Garnish with a dollop of peanut butter to your hearts desire. The sloppier, the better.
